text:
alice: heads-up — discovered CPU throttling on eu-west1 inference nodes after the 23:00 deploy. patch ready to hotfix, needs expedited approvals. low-risk binary bump to runtime worker (v1.4.7 -> v1.4.8).
ben: can you paste the perf diff and rollback plan?
mira: +1 to acceleration if rollback is trivial. how long is the change window?
alice: perf diff: p95 latency down 12% on sample traffic; CPU usage back to baseline. rollback plan: revert to v1.4.7, drain new tasks, restart workers. estimated impact <3m if rollback.
deploy-bot: deploy request received: service=runtime-worker region=eu-west1 image=rw/runtime:v1.4.8 requester=alice approvals_required=2 canary_minutes=10 change_window=23:30-00:15
sre-oncall: I'm oncall — +1 pending confirm on traffic-shift steps and metrics. recommend canary hold at 5% then 25 then 100 if green.
sam: I can approve if we pin model variant so tokenizer changes don't hit the canary. propose pin to model=rw-2b:v2026-03-15 for this rollout.
dina: QA smoke verified on staging for the binary bump. no regressions in decoder path. logs: `ERROR` count unchanged.
ben: ok — I'm +1. specifying rollback trigger: p95 latency increase >20% for two consecutive 1-min windows OR error rate >0.5%.
alice: noted. I'll start the deploy once we have 2 approvals. adding runbook link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/cpu-throttle-hotfix
sre-oncall: approved. I'll watch telemetry and be ready to rollback.
deploy-bot: approvals now: 2/2. scheduling canary start at 23:34 UTC. executing canary rollout.
alice: starting traffic-shift stages: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. will post status after each stage.
mira: can you also tag the release notes? small blurb: "Fix: runtime worker CPU throttling under sustained tails — improves p95 latency"
sam: tagging model pin in release notes.
deploy-bot: canary stage complete 5% -> metrics nominal. proceeding to 25%.
alice: 25% healthy. proceeding to full.
dina: rolling smoke tests passing at 25%.
ben: full rollout green. leaving note: revert runbook command: `kubectl set image deployment/runtime-worker runtime=rw/runtime:v1.4.7 -n prod-eu`
sre-oncall: monitoring for 15m post-rollout. if anything, call pager. :rotating_light:
alice: thanks team. closing the loop for incident channel and will attach changelog entry.
mira: nice work, fast approvals. :thumbsup:
